unfortunately
/ʌnˈfɔːtʃənətli/ adverb. 不幸地（用于表达令人失望或糟糕的情况）
dull

phrases: get round
消息传开；传播
When the news got round, everyone came to see.
消息传开后，大家都来看了。
queue for
排队等候
We had to queue for hours to get in.
我们不得不排了好几个小时的队才能进去。
burst out laughing
突然大笑起来
As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
他一开口，大家就突然大笑起来。
stand before
站在...前面
He stood awkwardly before the microphone.
他尴尬地站在麦克风前。
at the beginning of
在...开始时
He spoke at the beginning of the programme.
他在节目开始时讲话。
failed to do
未能做到；没能做成
Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed.
那些没能进去的人不必感到失望。
should have done
本应该做（但实际没做）
Many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
许多本应该出现的艺人没有来。
need not have done
本不必做（但实际做了）
Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed.
那些没能进去的人本不必感到失望。
open one's mouth
张嘴；开口说话
As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
他一开口，大家就大笑起来。
good ladies, evening and gentlemen
女士们，晚上好（的错误说法）
What he actually said was: 'Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
他实际说的是：'女士们好，晚上和先生们！'

grammar.k: 情态动词need的用法（needn't have done）
grammar.f: 主语 + needn't have + 过去分词
grammar.d: needn't have + 过去分词表示本不必做某事（但实际上已经做了） 用于表达某动作是不必要的，但已经发生了
ex: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed.
那些没能进去的人本不必感到失望。
You needn't have waited for me.

grammar.k: 情态动词should的用法（should have done）
grammar.f: 主语 + should have + 过去分词
grammar.d: should have + 过去分词表示本应该做某事（但实际没做） 用于表达遗憾或责备，暗示期望与现实的差距
ex: Many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
许多本应该出现的艺人没有来。
I should have studied harder for the exam.
我本应该更努力学习考试的。

grammar.d: when引导的时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的背景或时机 when在此处意为'当...的时候'或'当...的消息传开时'
ex: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented, we all rushed to see it.
当免费喜剧表演的消息传开时，我们都赶去看。

patterns.p: People will do anything to + 动词原形
o: People will do anything to see a free show--even if it is a bad one.
人们会做任何事去看免费表演——即使是很糟糕的。
im: People will do anything to get a bargain.
人们会做任何事来买到便宜货。
Students will do anything to pass the exam.
学生们会做任何事来通过考试。

patterns.p: When the news got round that...
o: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented at our local cinema, we all rushed to see it.
当喜剧表演将在当地电影院上演的消息传开时，我们都赶去看。
im: When the news got round that the store was closing down, everyone rushed there.
当那家店即将关门的消息传开时，大家都赶了过去。
When the news got round that he won the lottery, his phone never stopped ringing.
当他中彩票的消息传开时，他的电话响个不停。

o: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser.
那天晚上我们听到的唯一有趣的事情来自那个广告商。
im: The only food left in the fridge was some old bread.
冰箱里剩下的唯一食物是一些旧面包。
The only person who understood the problem was the teacher.
唯一理解这个问题的人是老师。

patterns.p: 主语 + be obviously + 形容词/副词
o: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
他显然非常紧张，在麦克风前笨拙地站了好几分钟。
im: She was obviously very tired after the long journey.
长途旅行后，她显然非常疲惫。
The student was obviously very nervous during the presentation.
那个学生在做报告时显然非常紧张。
